zh.title: 漢光演習第3天新竹基地演練跑道搶修與幻象緊急起飛
zh.summary: 國軍漢光42號實兵演習第3天，空軍第2戰術戰鬥機聯隊在新竹基地執行幻象2000戰機潛力裝掛、跑道搶修及緊急起飛演練，展現作戰韌性與持續力。
body: 國軍漢光42號實兵演習進入第3天，演習想定為共軍以飛彈襲台，國防部邀請媒體赴空軍第2戰術戰鬥機聯隊駐地新竹基地採訪。空軍在基地執行幻象2000戰機空對空飛彈潛力裝掛、跑道搶修及戰機緊急起飛等演練。
在潛力裝掛演練方面，2聯隊機務分隊為幻象2000單座機（機號2035）掛載魔法二型與雲母飛彈。魔法二型屬空對空短程飛彈，由官兵徒手搬運掛載於機翼下；屬中程飛彈的雲母飛彈則由專用掛彈車掛載在機腹。此次裝載構型為「恢復」標準防空外型，分別掛載2枚雲母飛彈、2枚魔法飛彈及2個副油箱。
跑道搶修演練模擬跑道遭共軍飛彈炸出巨型坑洞，設施中隊依序由輪式挖土機、傾卸車、壓路機等重型機具將彈坑回填並壓實，再以堆高機及人力將玻璃纖維墊展開組合，拖至修補彈坑上方完成復原。設施中隊中隊長林至軒中校表示，規範是以4小時內完成彈坑填補，目前以無人機進行跑道受損勘查。
2聯隊最後在基地南側南警戒室演練緊急起飛任務，2架幻象2000單座機採攜掛2枚雲母飛彈、2枚魔法飛彈與2個翼下副油箱的防空警戒外型，執行6分鐘警戒姿態。警鈴一響後，飛行員與地勤人員奔向戰機完成檢整作業，2架戰機在不到5分鐘內滑出警戒機堡執行起飛任務。
空軍指出，潛力裝掛是指專業人員應於指定時限內完成戰機各項武器外載、副油箱裝掛作業，依戰備需求區分為「完成」及「恢復」戰備。聯隊幹部與待命飛行員在演練時均配戴國造T75K3手槍並穿著戰術背心與頭盔，模擬戰時狀態。

en.title: Han Kuang Exercise Day 3: Hsinchu Base Drills Runway Repair and Mirage Emergency Takeoff
en.summary: On the third day of Taiwan's Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise, the Air Force's 2nd Tactical Fighter Wing conducted Mirage 2000 missile loading, runway crater repair, and emergency scramble drills at Hsinchu Air Base under a scenario simulating a missile attack on Taiwan.
body: The Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise entered its third day with a scenario simulating a PLA missile attack on Taiwan. The Ministry of National Defense invited media to cover the drills at the Hsinchu base, home to the Air Force's 2nd Tactical Fighter Wing. The Air Force conducted Mirage 2000 air-to-air missile loading, runway repair, and emergency fighter takeoff exercises.

For the weapons loading drill, the wing's maintenance unit loaded Magic II and MICA missiles onto a single-seat Mirage 2000 (aircraft number 2035). The Magic II, a short-range air-to-air missile, was loaded by hand onto the wing; the MICA, a medium-range missile, was loaded onto the fuselage using a dedicated bomb-loading vehicle. The configuration was the "restore" standard air defense loadout: two MICA missiles, two Magic missiles, and two drop tanks.

The runway repair drill simulated a large crater caused by an enemy missile strike. The facilities squadron used excavators, dump trucks, and rollers to backfill and compact the crater, then deployed fiberglass mats over the repaired area. Squadron leader Major Lin Zhi-xuan stated the standard is to complete crater filling within four hours, with drones currently used to assess runway damage.

The wing concluded with an emergency takeoff drill at the south alert facility. Two single-seat Mirage 2000s, carrying two MICA missiles, two Magic missiles, and two underwing drop tanks, executed a six-minute alert posture. After the alarm sounded, pilots and ground crew rushed to the aircraft, and both fighters taxied out of the alert shelter in under five minutes to execute their takeoff mission.

The Air Force stated that weapons loading requires specialized personnel to complete external weapon and drop tank loading within a designated time limit, categorized as either "complete" or "restore" combat readiness. Wing officers and standby pilots wore domestically produced T75K3 pistols, tactical vests, and helmets to simulate wartime conditions.

zh.title: A320 B-LPN 觀測抵達桃園機場
zh.summary: 公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示，註冊號 B-LPN 的 Airbus A320 於 2026 年 8 月 7 日確認抵達臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE），呼號 CRK261。
body: 公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示，一架註冊號為 B-LPN 的 Airbus A320 航空器於 2026 年 8 月 7 日被觀測抵達臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）。本站監測系統記錄到該航空器的首次有效觀測時間為 2026-08-07T09:37:44Z，確認抵達時間則為 2026-08-07T11:22:16Z。
觀測資料指出，該航空器的 ICAO hex 碼為 780a99，呼號為 CRK261，營運者 ICAO 代碼為 CRK，但營運者名稱欄位顯示為「未識別」。航空器 ICAO 機型代碼為 A320，機型顯示名稱為 Airbus A320。
抵達判定方面，系統將本次觀測標記為 confirmed_arrival，確認依據為「位於機場地理圍欄內且 alt_baro 為 ground」。本次觀測的主要資料來源為 Airplanes.live，第二資料來源為 ADSB.lol，交叉確認狀態為 secondary_unavailable。
機場資訊方面，觀測記錄顯示機場 ICAO 代碼為 RCTP，機場名稱為臺灣桃園國際機場。有效觀測筆數為 2 筆。
統計說明欄位指出，系統觀測歷史累積中，尚無可比較的長期統計。本站系統目前無法提供更長時間區間的比較數據，因此無法判斷此組合在歷史觀測中的出現頻率。
本次觀測的事件 ID 為 fw-b0b6dac6f0cfbc0f，資料類型為公開 ADS-B 觀測。由於營運者名稱為未識別，本報告僅依觀測資料記錄航空器型號與註冊號，不對營運者身分進行推測。

en.title: Airbus A320 B-LPN observed arriving at Taoyuan International Airport (TPE)
en.summary: Public ADS-B observation data shows an Airbus A320 registered as B-LPN, using callsign CRK261, confirmed arriving at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE) on 7 August 2026.
body: Public ADS-B observation data indicates that an Airbus A320 aircraft, registration B-LPN, was observed arriving at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport on 7 August 2026. The site's monitoring system recorded the first valid observation at 2026-08-07T09:37:44Z and confirmed arrival at 2026-08-07T11:22:16Z.

The observation data identifies the aircraft's ICAO hex code as 780a99, with callsign CRK261. The operator ICAO code is listed as CRK, while the operator name field shows "未識別" (unidentified). The aircraft ICAO type code is A320, with the display model name Airbus A320.

The arrival determination was marked as confirmed_arrival, with the confirmation basis stated as the aircraft being within the airport geofence and alt_baro reading as ground. The primary data source for this observation is Airplanes.live, with ADSB.lol listed as the secondary data source. Cross-confirmation status is recorded as secondary_unavailable.

Regarding airport information, the observation record shows the airport ICAO code as RCTP, named Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport. The total number of valid observation entries for this event is 2.

The statistics note indicates that the system's observation history is still accumulating, with no comparable long-term statistics available. The site's system therefore cannot provide frequency comparison data over a longer time window for this particular combination of aircraft and airport.

The event ID for this observation is fw-b0b6dac6f0cfbc0f, with the data type recorded as public ADS-B observation. As the operator name is listed as unidentified, this report records only the aircraft type and registration number from the observation data without speculating on the operator's identity.
